event.label: Russian attacks on Ukraine’s power system
event.description: Reports about the February 10 missile and drone attacks on Ukraine’s energy sites, their effects and missiles crossing Moldova. Sputnik’s selected liveblog includes a Russian statement published February 11 about the February 10 attack.

topics.label: Which power sites were damaged?
topics.scope_note: Regional damage claims concern different places and waves of attack; they are not automatically independent confirmation of one identical strike.

topics.label: Did the wider system keep working?
topics.scope_note: Keeping the grid connected does not mean no facilities were hit or no power cuts occurred.

topics.label: Russia’s claims about military effects
topics.scope_note: Claims that targets were hit or military supplies interrupted are attributed to Russia’s defense ministry and not independently verified.

topics.label: Where did missiles fly?
topics.scope_note: A confirmed Moldovan violation is not confirmation of entry into Romanian airspace. One missile confirmed is not necessarily a denial that two flew.

topics.label: Moldova’s response
topics.scope_note: Condemning a violation and ordering a diplomatic summons are related actions by different Moldovan institutions.

topics.label: When did Russia comment?
topics.scope_note: No confirmation yet on February 10 is not a denial or a contradiction of a statement published February 11.

method.country_note: Outlet countries describe origin. Claimant countries describe an office, organization or stated residence, not assumed citizenship.
method.claim_type_note: A fact claim is a checkable statement, not a fact verified by this graph. Opinions, predictions, legal positions and promises are marked separately.
method.edge_note: Green arrows point from a claim supplying a reason, example or reported statement to the specified part of another claim. Grey comparisons have no assigned evidential direction. Solid red connections mark proposed contradictions between specific claims or assessments. An arrow is used for an explicit rebuttal of a matching claim. Repeated reports of the same statement share a source.
method.attention_note: Attention is a qualitative reading of the saved article, with paragraph locators; it is not a measured share of words.
method.endorsement_note: A quoted speaker’s view is separate from the article narrator’s view. No outlet-wide position is inferred from one article.
method.cleaning_note: Uses saved recovered text. Kyiv Independent later Most Popular / News Feed material is excluded; original paragraph numbers retained. FT wrapped lines are joined into logical paragraphs. Sputnik entry timestamps are retained in where_when fields; February 11 military updates are not mislabeled as February 10 statements.
